mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS payment_id, p.order_id, o.order_number, p.pg_transaction_id, p.amount FROM payment p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN' AND o.status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING' AND p.updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{thresholdMinutes} MINUTE) AND p.id > #{lastId} AND p.is_deleted = false ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'DONE', approved_at = NOW(6), refundable_amount = amount, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN'
UPDATE payment SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = 'PG_RECONCILIATION_FAILED', failure_message = 'PG 대사 결과 승인 실패', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN'
UPDATE orders SET status = 'PAID', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_status_history (payment_id, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{paymentId}, 'DONE', NOW(6), NOW(6), false)
INSERT INTO payment_status_history (payment_id, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{paymentId}, 'FAILED', NOW(6), NOW(6), false)
mapper.select: SELECT pr.member_id AS memberId, pr.amount, pr.status, pb.balance, pb.reserved_amount AS reservedAmount FROM point_reservation pr JOIN point_balance pb ON pb.member_id = pr.member_id WHERE pr.payment_id = #{paymentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT used_point_amount FROM payment WHERE id = #{paymentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE point_reservation SET status = 'USED', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE point_reservation SET status = 'RELEASED', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_ledger (member_id, order_id, type, amount, balance_after, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{orderId}, 'USE', -#{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, NOW(6), NOW(6), false)
